build_Vig_backbone: build a Vision GNN backbone model with tiny, small, or base architecture for image feature extraction
build_PyramidVig_backbone: build a Pyramid Vision GNN backbone with multi-stage feature extraction using tiny, small, medium, or base architecture
build_DyGraphConv2d_layer: build a dynamic graph convolution layer that computes KNN graph and applies graph convolution on image features
build_Grapher_module: build a Grapher module combining dynamic graph convolution with feed-forward network and residual connection
build_sincos_positional_embedding: build 2D sinusoidal positional embeddings for a given grid size and embedding dimension
